description: This file defines the TopicPartitionInfo class, which models information about a message queue topic partition, including its topic name, tenant ID, partition number, and internal partition usage. It provides methods for constructing, comparing, and modifying instances, as well as static utilities for handling sets of such objects.

classes.name: TopicPartitionInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a specific partition of a message queue topic, including topic name, tenant ID, partition number, and internal partition flag.

methods.name: TopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields and constructing the full topic name based on tenant ID and partition.

methods.name: TopicPartitionInfo
methods.description: Overloaded constructor with default useInternalPartition set to false.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the tenant ID.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the partition number.

methods.name: withTopic
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified topic.

methods.name: withUseInternalPartition
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified internal partition usage flag.
